fullDescription: Experience the finest of northern Tanzania’s legendary parks on a journey crafted for discerning travelers. itinerary.description:
Arrive in Arusha and continue to Tarangire National Park, renowned for its towering baobab trees and impressive elephant herds.
Tarangire is famed for its diverse landscapes and nine distinct vegetation zones, but its true icons are the ancient baobab trees—towering giants that dwarf the wildlife around them—and its abundant elephant herds, the largest concentration in the country. The park’s Tarangire River attracts an incredible variety of wildlife, including lions, leopards, zebras, giraffes, buffaloes, antelopes, and numerous bird species.

Enjoy an afternoon private game drive customized to your interests, offering excellent opportunities for wildlife viewing and photography as you explore the park’s diverse habitats.

End the day with sunset cocktails set against Tarangire’s serene landscape, soaking in the warm hues of the African sky as the wilderness comes alive around you.

itinerary.description:
Depart from the lodge to Lake Manyara, a park celebrated for its colorful flamingos, legendary tree-climbing lions, and remarkable diversity of bird species.

Begin your day with private game drives along the lakeshore, exploring lush forests, open plains, and the vibrant wetlands teeming with wildlife. In the afternoon, continue your adventure with optional guided nature walks or a photography-focused safari, capturing the magical golden light over the water.

As evening approaches, unwind at your lodge, enjoying peaceful lake views and the tranquil atmosphere that surrounds this beautiful setting.
itinerary.meals: Lunch & dinner (Breakfast not included) All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

itinerary.description:
Ascend to the breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater, one of the world’s most extraordinary wildlife sanctuaries and a true natural wonder.

Descend onto the crater floor for an exclusive private game drive, where you’ll encounter endangered rhinos, powerful lions, grazing zebras, and flocks of elegant flamingos set against dramatic volcanic scenery.

Savor a gourmet bush lunch overlooking the vast crater, surrounded by sweeping panoramic views and the sounds of the wilderness.

In the evening, retreat to your accommodation in Serengeti National Park, perfect for stargazing beneath crystal-clear skies or enjoying a romantic private dinner in the bush.
itinerary.meals: All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater - Africa's Natural Amphitheater

itinerary.description:
Journey onward to the legendary Serengeti, Tanzania’s most iconic wildlife sanctuary and home to some of the greatest concentrations of animals on Earth.

In the afternoon, enjoy a private game drive through the Central Serengeti, where you’ll have the chance to observe lions lounging in the grasslands, elephants moving gracefully across the plains, and vast herds of zebras and wildebeest grazing in their natural habitat.

For a perfect end to the day, opt for a scenic sundowner atop a rocky kopje, offering sweeping panoramic views and exceptional opportunities for golden-hour photography.
itinerary.meals: All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)

itinerary.description:
Begin your day with a final morning game drive in the Serengeti, taking in one last opportunity to witness Africa’s iconic wildlife in their natural habitat—whether it’s lions on the hunt, elephants moving across the plains, or herds of antelope grazing in the early light.

By midday, start your journey back to Arusha, enjoying the ever-changing scenery as you leave the vast savannahs behind. An optional lunch stop along the way allows you to relax and reflect on the unforgettable experiences of your safari.

Upon arrival in Arusha, continue with your onward travel plans or prepare for departure, bringing your remarkable adventure to a close.

itinerary.description:
After a short briefing in the morning, you set off to the Lake Manyara National Park. The small park stretches along the 600 m high Rift Valley Escarpment and is dominated by the alkaline Lake Manyara. It is here where thousands of flamingos seem to colour the shallow waters pink. Many water birds gather at the lake and more than 400 bird species are found in the park.

The diverse vegetation provides a habitat for many animals such as monkeys in the forest, giraffes and antelopes on the grasslands and elephants around the acacia trees. If you are very lucky you might also see the Manyara lions, lounging in the trees. In the late afternoon you will leave the Lake Manyara National Park and head to the Neptune Ngorongoro Luxury Lodge, where you will spend the night.

itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive through the fertile crater highlands, where the Iraqw people cultivate wheat, corn, and coffee. Passing the Ngorongoro Crater, continue toward the vast Serengeti plains, arriving around midday.

Serengeti National Park is one of Africa’s most iconic wildlife destinations, renowned for its endless plains and rich diversity of animals. Large herds of wildebeest, buffalo, elephants, giraffes, eland, impalas, and gazelles roam the landscape, while predators such as lions and leopards are frequently spotted. The park features varied habitats, including open plains, savannah, bush, swamps, kopjes, and seasonal lakes. Depending on the time of year, you may witness the great wildebeest migration.

Enjoy a game drive through this remarkable ecosystem, stopping for a scenic picnic lunch before continuing your exploration.

As the day ends, return to your lodge for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.meals: All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)
itinerary.title: Lake Manyara – Serengeti National Park

itinerary.description: Dawn is a good time to watch wildlife and so you will be up early to join an early morning game drive. You will return to the camp for breakfast before heading out for another game drive in the park. Here in the Seronera region you will often see wildebeests and zebras in close proximity of lions and other predators such as leopards and cheetahs. After a picnic lunch you will continue your journey towards the Ngorongoro Crater. Once you have reached the crater rim you will enjoy fantastic views of this 600 m deep collapsed volcano. You will stay at the Ngorongoro Lion’s Paw Camp, situated on the crater rim.
itinerary.meals: All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)
itinerary.title: Serengeti – Ngorongoro Crater

itinerary.description: After an early breakfast you will drive down the steep and narrow road that takes you into the crater. The slopes are forested but soon the landscape changes to savannah. Here the wildlife is just breath-taking and with a little luck you can observe the Big Five – lion, elephant, buffalo, rhino and leopard – in just a few hours. You should also see warthogs, wildebeests, zebras, hippos and some of the more than 500 bird species of the area. After a morning dedicated to game viewing and a picnic lunch, you will leave the crater in the early afternoon to drive back to Arusha, where you will arrive in the early evening.

fullDescription: Embark on an adventure beginning and ending at Kilimanjaro International Airport as you explore Tanzania’s iconic wildlife destinations. Visit Tarangire National Park, the UNESCO-listed Ngorongoro Crater, and scenic Lake Manyara National Park. This unforgettable safari includes airport transfers, a professional driver-guide, all meals and drinking water, park fees, and a private 4x4 safari vehicle with a pop-up roof for comfortable and immersive wildlife viewing.

itinerary.description:
Arrival in the morning at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your driver-guide and transferred to Tarangire National Park. Early arrival is recommended to maximize your safari experience.

The scenic drive takes approximately two and a half hours, passing through the heart of Tanzania’s stunning landscapes. Upon arrival, your guide will assist with park registration before embarking on your first game drive.

Tarangire National Park is renowned for its rich biodiversity and large elephant populations. Its varied landscapes range from seasonal swamps to open savannah, with the Tarangire River flowing through the park. You might witness a lion stalking its prey or spot leopards lounging in the branches above.

In the afternoon, you’ll enjoy your packed lunch inside the park. By 4:00 PM, your game drive will come to an end, and you’ll drive to your lodge for dinner, relaxation, and an overnight stay.
itinerary.meals: Lunch & dinner (Breakfast not included) All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)
itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park – Majestic Landscapes & Wildlife Encounters

itinerary.description:
Wake up to a stunning morning and enjoy a delicious breakfast before departing at 6:30 AM. for the Ngorongoro Crater.

You will spend the day exploring this extraordinary natural wonder, discovering the rich diversity of wildlife that inhabits the crater floor. After lunch, you will continue with an afternoon game drive until late afternoon.

The centerpiece of Ngorongoro is its vast volcanic crater—the largest intact, unflooded caldera in the world. Measuring approximately 20 kilometers in diameter, 600 meters deep, and covering about 300 square kilometers, it is a truly breathtaking natural phenomenon. During the exploration, you will visit Lake Magadi, a shallow alkaline lake located in the southwestern part of the crater, renowned for sightings of black rhinos, flamingos, hippos, and a wide variety of other water birds.

After game drive, you will return to your accommodation, where dinner and a restful overnight stay await.
itinerary.meals: All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater – The Big Five Adventure

itinerary.description:

Located at the base of the Great Rift Valley, Lake Manyara National Park is renowned for its diverse landscapes and abundant wildlife. The Park is especially famous for its tree-climbing lions, as well as sightings of elephants, giraffes, and a wide variety of birdlife drawn to the alkaline waters of Lake Manyara. You will enjoy a rewarding game drive through lush groundwater forests, open plains, and lakeshore habitats.

After your visit, you will continue on to Kilimanjaro International Airport, where your safari comes to an end. Depending on your flight schedule, you may arrive earlier to allow for a smooth departure.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast & lunch (Dinner not included) All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)
itinerary.title: Lake Manyara National Park Scenic Landscapes & Tree-Climbing Lions

Lake Manyara is a shallow, alkaline lake at the base of the Western Rift Valley escarpment. The park entrance leads to a beautiful groundwater forest. This park is known for its large elephant population. The lions are present, but not seen that easily. The forest patch is home to habituated troops of olive baboon and blue monkey. Buffalo, giraffe and several antelope species are easily encountered on a drive.

The game drive ends at 4:00 PM, after which you will drive to your lodge for dinner, relaxation, and an overnight stay.

After breakfast we head towards the Serengeti National Park, via the beautiful high lying farmland of Karatu and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Leaving the highlands behind, we descend into the heart of wild Africa – the Serengeti National Park – with its endless plains, rolling into the distance as far as the eye can see. We head to the central park area, one of the richest wildlife habitats in the park, featuring the Seronera River, which provides a valuable water source to this area and therefore attracts wildlife well representative of most of the Serengeti’s species. We'll stop for lunch and enjoy an afternoon game drive in the Serengeti National Park.

Later, you’ll head to your accommodation for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.meals: All meals included All drinks (Except for spirits/liquor)
itinerary.title: Lake Manyara to Serengeti National Park

itinerary.description:
Starting your full day game drive by 8 AM after a filling breakfast, you will explore the central portion of the Serengeti National Park today.

The legendary Serengeti National Park is the most renowned safari destination for its incredible population of lions and leopards. The central portion of the Serengeti – known as Seronera area is one of the richest wildlife habitats in the park. It features the Seronera River, which provides a valuable water source to this area and therefore attracts wildlife well representative of most of the Serengeti’s species.

During the off season of the migration, one must really look out for the many lion prides that thrive in this region. The interactions and survival of these lion prides provide an excellent game viewing experience all year round. Along with a picnic lunch during the full day game drive, the game end by around 5PM.

The long day comes to an end with a heavy dinner and a good night’s rest in your accommodation.

This iconic park teems with diverse animals—impalas, buffalo, crocodiles, and hippos roam its landscapes—but it is most celebrated for the Great Migration: sweeping herds of 250,000 zebras, 1.5 million wildebeest, and 500,000 antelopes following the rains in a timeless rhythm. Alongside these vast moving herds, you may encounter formidable predators, including lions, leopards, and cheetahs, as they stalk the plains.

At the close of your game drive, you’ll return to your lodge nestled within the Serengeti, where you can relax, enjoy a delicious dinner, and spend the night accompanied by the tranquil sounds of the wilderness.

Spend the day exploring this extraordinary natural wonder, renowned for its dense wildlife population on the crater floor. After lunch, continue with an afternoon game drive until late afternoon, discovering the crater’s diverse landscapes and animals.

The highlight of Ngorongoro is its vast volcanic crater, the largest intact and unflooded caldera in the world. Measuring about 20 kilometers in diameter, 600 meters deep, and covering approximately 300 square kilometers, it offers breathtaking scenery. During the visit, you will explore Lake Magadi, a shallow alkaline lake in the southwestern part of the crater, known for sightings of black rhinos, hippos, flamingos, and many water bird species.

Depart from Arusha and journey toward the Ndutu area, where the southern plains of the Serengeti meet the Ngorongoro Conservation Area.

The Ndutu calving season, a pinnacle of the Great Wildebeest Migration, typically takes place from late January to March. During this period, over 400,000 wildebeest calves are born, drawn to the lush, nutrient-rich grasses that flourish after the short rains. The Southern Serengeti and Ndutu transform into a vibrant nursery, where newborns are safeguarded—and hunted—amid the presence of predators such as lions, cheetahs, and hyenas.

After an immersive day tracking the herds, a packed lunch will be served at a scenic picnic spot within the park. As the day draws to a close, you’ll return to your accommodation for dinner and an overnight stay.

This premium safari takes you through Tarangire National Park, Ngorongoro Crater, and Lake Manyara, offering intimate wildlife encounters and breathtaking landscapes from the comfort of luxury accommodations.
highlights: Ngorongoro Crater - the world's largest intact caldera

itinerary.description:
After a short briefing in the morning, you set off to the Lake Manyara National Park. The small park stretches along the 600 m high Rift Valley Escarpment and is dominated by the alkaline Lake Manyara. It is here where thousands of flamingos seem to colour the shallow waters pink. Many water birds gather at the lake and more than 400 bird species are found in the park.

The diverse vegetation provides a habitat for many animals such as monkeys in the forest, giraffes and antelopes on the grasslands and elephants around the acacia trees. If you are very lucky you might also see the Manyara lions, lounging in the trees. In the late afternoon you will leave the Lake Manyara National Park and head to the Kirurumu Manyara Lodge, where you will spend the night.
itinerary.title: Arusha – Lake Manyara National Park

itinerary.description:
After breakfast you will drive towards the fertile crater highlands where the Iraqw people grow wheat, corn and coffee. You will pass the Ngorongoro Crater before you reach the plains of the Serengeti National Park around midday. The Serengeti is the largest park in Tanzania and has a diversity of habitats and landscapes including short grass plains, savannah, thick bush, swamps, mountains and lakes. Bizarre rock formations called Kopjes dot the grassy landscape where predators are often seen. Depending on the season you will witness the migration of thousands of animals which this park is famous for.

During the short rainy season in November and December the herds move from the hills in the north to the plains in the south. During the longer rainy season from April to June they return up north. This circle of life is completely dependent on the yearly rainfalls and the locations of the herds may vary from year to year but your guide will know where to find the animals and where to see them best. You will spend the night at the Kati Kati Tented Camp.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast, Lunch
itinerary.title: Lake Manyara – Serengeti National Park

itinerary.description: Dawn is a good time to watch wildlife and so you will be up early to join an early morning game drive. You will return to the camp for breakfast before heading out for another game drive in the park. Here in the Seronera region you will often see wildebeests and zebras in close proximity of lions and other predators such as leopards and cheetahs. After a picnic lunch you will continue your journey towards the Ngorongoro Crater. Once you have reached the crater rim you will enjoy fantastic views of this 600 m deep collapsed volcano. You will stay at the Ang’ata Ngorongoro Camp, situated on the crater rim
itinerary.meals: Lunch, Dinner
itinerary.title: Serengeti – Ngorongoro Crater

itinerary.description: After an early breakfast you will drive down the steep and narrow road that takes you into the crater. The slopes are forested but soon the landscape changes to savannah. Here the wildlife is just breath-taking and with a little luck you can observe the Big Five – lion, elephant, buffalo, rhino and leopard – in just a few hours. You should also see warthogs, wildebeests, zebras, hippos and some of the more than 500 bird species of the area. After a morning dedicated to game viewing and a picnic lunch, you will leave the crater in the early afternoon to drive back to Arusha, where you will arrive in the early evening.

The area is world-renowned in its reputation and very small in its scale, so you will see other safari-goers. title: 3 Days Serengeti Classic Safari

description: Experience the magic of Tanzania on this 5-day adventure through Tarangire, Serengeti, and Ngorongoro Crater.
fullDescription:
Embark on a magical 5-day journey through Tanzania's most spectacular wildlife destinations. This comprehensive safari combines the elephant-rich Tarangire, the legendary Serengeti plains, and the breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater.

Experience diverse ecosystems, incredible wildlife concentrations, and the raw beauty of East Africa. This safari offers the perfect balance of adventure and comfort, with opportunities to see the Big Five and countless other species.

itinerary.description: Pick up from your hotel in Arusha at 8:30 AM and drive to Lake Manyara National Park, enjoy full day game drive with picnic lunch. Lake Manyara is a shallow, alkaline lake at the base of the Western Rift Valley escarpment. The park entrance leads to a beautiful groundwater forest. This park is known for its large elephant population. The lions are present, but not seen that easily. The forest patch is home to habituated troops of olive baboon and blue monkey. Buffalo, giraffe and several antelope species are easily encountered on a drive.
itinerary.title: Arusha to Lake Manyara National Park

itinerary.description: After breakfast we head towards the Serengeti National Park, via the beautiful high lying farmland of Karatu and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Leaving the highlands behind, we descend into the heart of wild Africa – the Serengeti National Park – with its endless plains, rolling into the distance as far as the eye can see. We head to the central park area, known as the Seronera area, one of the richest wildlife habitats in the park, featuring the Seronera River, which provides a valuable water source to this area and therefore attracts wildlife well representative of most of the Serengeti’s species. We arrive in time for lunch and enjoy an afternoon game drive in the Serengeti National Park.
itinerary.title: Lake Manyara to Serengeti National Park

itinerary.description:
Starting your full day game drive by 8 AM after a filling breakfast, you will explore the central portion of the Serengeti National Park today. The legendary Serengeti National Park is the most renowned safari destination for its incredible population of lions and leopards. The central portion of the Serengeti – known as Seronera area is one of the richest wildlife habitats in the park. It features the Seronera River, which provides a valuable water source to this area and therefore attracts wildlife well representative of most of the Serengeti’s species.

During the off season of the migration, one must really look out for the many lion prides that thrive in this region. The interactions and survival of these lion prides provide an excellent game viewing experience all year round. Along with a picnic lunch during the full day game drive, the day will come to a close by around 5PM. The long day comes to an end with a heavy dinner and a good night’s rest in your accommodation.
itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park

itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will have a morning game drive in Serengeti National Park. Later depart for Ngorongoro Crater Rim with picnic lunch. Ngorongoro Crater is the largest collapsed volcanic crater in the world and fourteen kilometers of isolated natural beauty. Ngorongoro Crater is surrounded by a ring of extinct volcanoes and the floor, dotted with watering holes, shelters some 30,000 animals. The eventful day comes to an end with a heavy dinner and a good night’s rest in your accommodation.
itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Conservation Area

itinerary.description:
On the last day of your safari, you will have an early start. Finishing up with a quick breakfast you will make an early descend at around 6:30 AM into the crater floor. The Ngorongoro Crater is the world’s largest inactive, intact and unfilled volcanic caldera. It has a massive floor of about 260 sq kms with a depth of over 2000 feet. The 5-hour game drive in the crater floor, will show you a lot of animal action.

Keeping the camera ready is definitely recommended. The African elephant, buffalo, Black rhino, Hippos, Hyenas, Cheetahs and Lions are found in plenty. Post the picnic lunch at the beautiful Hippo pool, you will begin a steep ascend to the top exit of the crater. This is the last leg of your safari, with a 4hr drive left to Arusha. You will be dropped off to your preferred location in Arusha by 6:00 PM in the evening. With an incredible experience and loads of memories to cherish, this is the time you bid goodbye to your team.
itinerary.title: Crater tour (5 hours game drive) to Arusha/Moshi.

title: 5 Days Tanzania Magic Safari

description: Witness the Great Migration on this epic 7-day safari through the Serengeti ecosystem and northern Tanzania.
fullDescription:
Experience one of nature's greatest spectacles - the Great Wildebeest Migration - on this comprehensive 7-day safari adventure. Follow millions of wildebeest and zebra across the Serengeti plains in their eternal search for fresh grasslands.

This extended safari provides ample time to explore different regions of the Serengeti, witness dramatic river crossings (seasonal), and enjoy diverse wildlife encounters across multiple ecosystems.

itinerary.description:
Breakfast before you drive to Tarangire National Park crossing the Maasai Steppe on your way to Tarangire National Park, Tanzania’s fourth-largest and one of its most diverse. Stop at the picturesque park gate for the driver to fill up the park registration book before you enter the park for the evening to sunset game drive in the park enjoying viewing animals.



Elephants, Buffalos, and pythons are seen easily and regularly cross your path, unbothered by your benign presence and going about their daily routines. You’ll meander along bush tracks, explore the Tarangire River’s twists and turns, and find elephants drinking and playing in the refreshing waters. Late this afternoon you’ll arrive at your campsite where you can settle in and relax before dinner and your first night in the bush.



Dinner and overnight at Tarangire Simba tented lodge.
itinerary.title: Arusha – Tarangire National Park

itinerary.description:
Early breakfast before you drive out with game sunrise game drives en-route to Lake Manyara national park. Lake Manyara National Park is among Tanzania’s smallest parks. Drive through the lush garden is a gentle reminder that you are now in Africa. Exotic birdcalls fill the air. Enjoy a picnic lunch and afterward, you’ll continue game viewing of animals in the park.

Zebra, wildebeest, bushbuck, dik-dik, and guinea fowl regularly cross your path, unbothered by your benign presence and going about their daily routines. You’ll meander along bush tracks and explore the Lake which is home to thousands of Flamingos and rivers twists and turns, finding elephants drinking and playing in the refreshing waters. More game drives to sunset before you drive to the lodge for dinner and overnight.

Note: In the late afternoon you will do a short hike down the Great Rift Valley as well as a visit to Mto wa Mbu village. View birds, monkeys, bushbucks, and other forest animals. During the hike enjoy the sounds of the forest and the fresh streams and waterfalls surrounding you. Visit the Mto wa Mbu local village. Enjoy a short stroll on the edge of the Great Rift Valley with beautiful views of Lake Manyara and the National Park below. Learn more about plants, insects, birds, and small mammals from a knowledgeable guide.

Dinner and overnight at Acacia Farm Lodge.
itinerary.title: Tarangire National – Lake Manyara National Park

itinerary.description:
After breakfast, you will make your way to Serengeti National Park heading in a northwesterly direction. Head up the winding, switch-back road and into the Ngorongoro Highlands continue to the Serengeti National Park (endless plain) for the afternoon to sunset game drive before heading to your overnight camps for dinner and overnight.

Dinner and overnight at Serengeti Sopa Lodge.
itinerary.title: Lake Manyara - Serengeti National Park

itinerary.description:
Full days ‘discover Serengeti’ game drives. The day for the big cats – cheetahs, leopards, and lions. Mostly you will go out for a SUNRISE game drive at 0600am followed by b/fast at 0800am. More game drive till Lunchtime (picnic lunch). After your picnic lunch, you will proceed with your afternoon game drive en–route to the Mara River area for dinner and overnight.

Dinner and Overnight at Ole Serai tented camp.
itinerary.title: Central Serengeti Safari

itinerary.description:
Early breakfast before you drive for a full-day game drive in the Serengeti Park. On this day you will try to follow migration groups around the Mara River. In the evening drive back to the lodge for dinner and overnight. Some of the wildebeests’ groups don’t cross the river and you might catch them around the Mara River.

Dinner and overnight at Chaka tented camp.
itinerary.title: North Serengeti Mara River Area

itinerary.description:
SUNRISE game drives start at 06:00 am till 9:00 am. When you’ll depart the Mara River area with game drives en route to the Ngorongoro Crater rim for dinner and overnight. On the way, you will visit the Retima hippo pool.

Dinner and overnight at Ngorongoro lion paw lodge.
itinerary.title: North Serengeti Park/Ngorongoro Crater Rim

itinerary.description:
Rise early for breakfast before you spend a full day exploring the crater floor. The area is world-renowned in its reputation and very small in its scale, so you will see other safari-goers. Don’t let that distract you from the beauty of the place or from the fact that this remains one of the only places on earth where you may see all of the Big Five at once: Lion, Leopard, Bull Elephant, African Buffalo, and Black Rhino. To maximize your time on the crater floor you will enjoy a special boxed lunch at a scenic picnic spot.

Your journey will take you through this tremendous landscape that is constantly changing as animals move to and fro in search of pasture, water, or east prey.

In the afternoon, it is time to depart this Garden of Eden and drive back to Arusha for dinner and overnight
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Floor Back to Arusha

itinerary.description: 0830hrs drive from Arusha to Lake Manyara National Park for game drives with picnic lunch boxes. Lake Manyara is a good soft introduction to the safari experience. It is a magical and pretty park that winds its way around a mainly forested driving route between the banks of Soda Water Lake and the impressive rise of the Great Rift escarpment.
itinerary.title: Arusha – Lake Manyara National Park

itinerary.description:
After breakfast you will drive towards the fertile crater highlands where the Iraqw people grow wheat, corn and coffee. You will pass the Ngorongoro Crater before you reach the plains of the Serengeti National Park around midday. The Serengeti is the largest park in Tanzania and has a diversity of habitats and landscapes including short grass plains, savannah, thick bush, swamps, mountains and lakes. Bizarre rock formations called Kopjes dot the grassy landscape where predators are often seen. Depending on the season you will witness the migration of thousands of animals which this park is famous for.

During the short rainy season in November and December the herds move from the hills in the north to the plains in the south. During the longer rainy season from April to June they return up north. This circle of life is completely dependent on the yearly rainfalls and the locations of the herds may vary from year to year but your guide will know where to find the animals and where to see them best.
itinerary.title: Lake Manyara – Serengeti National Park

itinerary.description: 0630hrs early morning game drives in Serengeti National Park, late breakfast at Lodge, followed by another game drive, dinner and overnight at Public Camping Site
itinerary.title: Full Day Serengeti National Park

itinerary.title: Serengeti – Ngorongoro Crater

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater – Tarangire National Park

itinerary.description: After breakfast Tarangire National Park for game drives, Tarangire is well known for its big herds of Elephants and huge baobab trees plus other predators like lions and leopards. Hot lunch at the lodge or picnic lunch at the picnic site, later afternoon drive back to Arusha town and dropped off at Arusha  for dinner and overnight.
itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park – Arusha

title: 6 Days Tanzania Joy Safari

itinerary.description:
After a short briefing in the morning, you set off to the Lake Manyara National Park. The small park stretches along the 600 m high Rift Valley Escarpment and is dominated by the alkaline Lake Manyara. It is here where thousands of flamingos seem to colour the shallow waters pink. Many water birds gather at the lake and more than 400 bird species are found in the park.

The diverse vegetation provides a habitat for many animals such as monkeys in the forest, giraffes and antelopes on the grasslands and elephants around the acacia trees. If you are very lucky you might also see the Manyara lions, lounging in the trees. In the late afternoon you will leave the Lake Manyara National Park and head to the campsite, where you will spend the night.
itinerary.title: Arusha – Lake Manyara National Park

itinerary.description: Dawn is a good time to watch wildlife and so you will be up early to join an early morning game drive. You will return to the camp for breakfast before heading out for another game drive in the park. Here in the Seronera region you will often see wildebeests and zebras in close proximity of lions and other predators such as leopards and cheetahs. After a picnic lunch you will continue your journey towards the Ngorongoro Crater. Once you have reached the crater rim you will enjoy fantastic views of this 600 m deep collapsed volcano.
itinerary.title: Serengeti – Ngorongoro Crater

itinerary.description: After an early breakfast you will drive down the steep and narrow road that takes you into the crater. The slopes are forested but soon the landscape changes to savannah. Here the wildlife is just breath-taking and with a little luck you can observe the Big Five – lion, elephant, buffalo, rhino and leopard – in just a few hours. You should also see warthogs, wildebeests, zebras, hippos and some of the more than 500 bird species of the area. After a morning dedicated to game viewing and a picnic lunch, you will leave the crater in the early afternoon to drive back to Arusha, where you will arrive in the early evening.
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater – Arusha/Airport

title: 4 Days Affordable Camping Safari

description: This safari package offers an exhilarating opportunity to explore the most stunning parks in northern Tanzania. Journey through the Serengeti National Park, famous for its diverse landscapes ranging from the vast grasslands of the southeast to the hilly and rocky terrain in the north, and the valleys, rivers, and forests to the west. For an unforgettable safari adventure, choose Mambeu Safaris. Let us help you create memories that will last a lifetime, surrounded by the raw beauty of nature.

itinerary.description: Pick up at 6:30 AM from your hotel in Arusha and proceed towards Serengeti National Park, via the beautiful high lying farmland of Karatu and the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Leaving the highlands behind, we descend into the heart of wild Africa – the Serengeti National Park with its endless plains, rolling into the distance as far as the eye can see. We head to the central park area, known as the Seronera area, one of the richest wildlife habitats in the park, featuring the Seronera River, which provides a valuable water source to this area and therefore attracts wildlife well representative of most of the Serengeti’s species. We arrive in time for lunch and enjoy an afternoon game drive in the Serengeti National Park.
itinerary.title: Arusha to Serengeti National Park

itinerary.description: Today you will have a full day game drive in Serengeti with chances to see predators chasing their pray and enjoy their kill. Serengeti is undoubtedly the best-known wildlife sanctuary in the world, unequalled for its natural beauty and scientific value. You will have game drive in the endless plains of the Serengeti with a chance to see the great herds of wildebeest, zebras and gazelles or a pride of lions lounging in the shade.
itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park

itinerary.description: Enjoy early breakfast and meet your guide to have a last morning game drive in Serengeti National Park, later depart to Ngorongoro Conservation area with en-route game drive and picnic lunch. Ngorongoro is a special conservation area and not a National Park. The whole area is managed for both animals and local Maasai people who graze their cattle alongside the indigenous wildlife.
itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park to Ngorongoro Conservation Area

itinerary.description:
After breakfast, descend into the crater, enjoy 5 hours game drive in the crater. The Ngorongoro Crater is one of the most densely crowded African wildlife areas in the world and is home to an estimated 30,000 animals including some of Tanzania’s last remaining black rhino.

Supported by a year round water supply and fodder, the crater supports a vast variety of animals, which include herds of wildebeest, zebra, buffalo, eland, warthog, hippo, and giant African elephants. Another big draw card to this picturesque national park is its huge population of predators, which include lions, hyenas, jackals, cheetahs and the ever-elusive leopard. We will enjoy a picnic lunch on the crater floor.

Late afternoon drive back to Arusha and drop off at your hotel.
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater (5 hrs game drive) & back to Arusha

itinerary.description: Pick up at 8:30 AM from your hotel in Arusha and depart for Tarangire National Park with a picnic lunch for a full day game drive. Tanzania’s third largest National park is known for its majestic baobab trees that dot the landscape, dwarfing the animals that feed beneath them. The Tarangire River is the centerpiece of this park which is famous for some of the largest herds of elephants in Africa. Here you may see lion, leopard, cheetah, lesser kudu, buffalo, Oryx, eland, giraffe and zebra. Post the game drive, you will head back to your camp/lodge where a delicious dinner awaits you.
itinerary.title: Arusha – Tarangire National Park

itinerary.description: On the last day of your safari, you will have an early start. Finishing up with a quick breakfast you will make an early descent at around 6:30 AM into the crater floor. The Ngorongoro Crater is the world’s largest inactive, intact and unfilled volcanic caldera. It has a massive floor of about 260 sq kms with a depth of over 2000 feet. The 5-hour game drive on the crater floor will show you a lot of animal action. Keeping the camera ready is definitely recommended. The African elephant, buffalo, Black rhino, Hippos, Hyenas, Cheetahs and Lions are found in plenty. Post the picnic lunch at the beautiful Hippo pool, you will begin a steep ascend to the top exit of the crater. This is the last leg of your safari, with a 4hr drive left to Arusha. You will be dropped off to your preferred location in Arusha by 6:00 PM in the evening. With an incredible experience and loads of memories to cherish, this is the time you bid goodbye to your team.
itinerary.meals: Half Board
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Tour (5 Hours) to Arusha
